comparison.objective: Adjust two forearm crutches so their spring buttons fully engage the same marked hole.
comparison.physical_skill: Press a spring button, slide a telescoping leg through intermediate holes, and align for re-engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Both buttons centred within 1.5 mm and protruding at least 3 mm; crutches released and stable, with any drop failing.
comparison.reason: This is telescoping adjustment and spring-button latching, not mandrel-guided impact fracture or recovery of loose fragments.
